## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpectrogramElement> CreateSpectrogramElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSpectrogramElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
